levels.name: Leo, 22, Rideshare Rookie
levels.story: The 8 levels of rideshare ratings. Level 1. 2.400 Euro Miese diesen Monat? Wer hat den Typen in den Anzug gelassen? Vielleicht leckt er mir gleich die Fußmatten sauber. My rating is 4.20 and my battered sedan smells like stale french fries. You drive like a total maniac. He slammed my door so hard the rearview mirror shook. I swallowed the lump in my throat and gripped the steering wheel. Watch out for the pothole! Then my phone buzzed with an automated deactivation warning. Das siehst du in Level 2. You'll see that in Level 2.

levels.name: Maya, 25, Night Shift Driver
levels.story: The 8 levels of rideshare ratings. Level 2. Mit deiner 4.45-Bewertung kannst du dir nicht mal lauwarme Fischstäbchen leisten, Süße. Steig aus. My rating is 4.45 and I drive twelve hours straight just to cover my gas and car insurance. You'll never get luxury tips with a score like that, sweetheart. My chest tightened with humiliation because I worked twice as hard as anyone else. Just drop me off at the corner, hurry up. Then the rear door opened and a stranger dropped something heavy. Das siehst du in Level 3. You'll see that in Level 3.

levels.name: Oliver, 29, Weekend Hustler
levels.story: The 8 levels of rideshare ratings. Level 3. Vierzehn Stunden am Steuer, und die Alte im Pelzmantel kotzt fast wegen meiner Pizza-Reste. Noch ein Wort und ich werfe ihr Gepäck auf die Gleise. My rating is 4.62 and I thought I was doing okay until a woman in a fur coat got in. People with your score always miss the highway exits. I wanted to scream because I had been awake for fourteen hours straight funding my sister's tuition. Just keep your eyes on the road, man. Then she leaned forward and whispered something terrifying. Das siehst du in Level 4. You'll see that in Level 4.

levels.name: Chloe, 26, Airport Specialist
levels.story: The 8 levels of rideshare ratings. Level 4. Du denkst, deine 4.78 schützt dich vor meinem Anwalt? Mein Business-Jet wartet nicht auf Schlampen im Kleinwagen. My rating is 4.78 and I keep pristine leather seats and bottled water in my trunk. You think a 4.78 makes you special? My company pays for my Black XL rides exclusively. My blood boiled because I maintained five-star service through every chaotic airport rush. Hurry up to Terminal B, flight's boarding in twenty minutes. Then my dashcam beeped, recording every single insulting word. Das siehst du in Level 5. You'll see that in Level 5.

levels.name: Julian, 42, Rideshare King
levels.story: The 8 levels of rideshare ratings. Level 8. Du wolltest nach ganz oben? Herzlichen Glückwunsch, du bist bankrott. Schau dir deine Stirn an. My rating is a permanent 5.00 and I founded the entire rideshare network operating across this city. You think a five-star rating makes you invincible. I smiled calmly from the backseat because she was the exact driver I had been searching for. Are you serious? Is this a promotion? The rating system isn't a measure of your worth, it's a test of your hunger. What rating do you show on your forehead?
